entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Cycle-level injection-moulding response used to infer non-return-valve wear state without disassembling the barrel.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Bounded wear-state classification/monitoring feature; exact model inputs and wear classes remain study-specific.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: The measured study supports NRV wear monitoring on its tested machine, but a predicted wear state is not universal proof and requires maintenance/inspection confirmation.

evidence.role: measured non-return-valve wear and part-weight experiment

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Physical distinction among barrel-wall, nozzle-wall and mould-cavity pressure sensors in a controlled injection-moulding experiment.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Separate local pressure domains with independent sensors; sensor range/location and polymer context remain attached to each channel.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Barrel, nozzle and cavity pressures are related but not interchangeable; differences support process reasoning but do not define a universal pressure-loss or viscosity threshold.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Injection-mould cooling-channel health inferred from measured coolant volume flow and pressure drop under a defined supply/fluid condition.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Derived hydraulic resistance/condition feature from measured flow and pressure; geometry, fluid and supply condition are part of the calibration.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Rising hydraulic resistance can support contamination/fouling investigation, but the derived value is circuit-specific and is not a universal cleaning threshold.

entries.measurementLocationOrDomain: Distinction between directly measured residual resin moisture and dryer temperature/time or other commanded conditioning settings.
entries.unitsOrFeatureSemantics: Moisture analyzer/sensor result is a measured material state; dryer settings are commands/conditions and are not equivalent evidence.
entries.diagnosticUseBoundary: Measured moisture can corroborate moisture-related quality reasoning, but acceptable limits are resin-grade/supplier specific and cannot be inferred from dryer settings alone.

evidence.role: measured residual moisture linked to moulded quality
